Bolt pack=8 { count: UInt8[4], weight: Int16, lane: Int64, slot: Int8[2], code: UInt32 }
Bell pack=8 { stamp: UInt16[4], flags: UInt16, id: Int32, stop: Int8 }
Ribbon pack=8 { bay: Bolt, lane: Int8, batch: UInt8[2], zone: Bolt, tier: Int16, slot: Int8 }
Tag pack=8 { mass: Int16, stop: Bell, grade: Int32[2], count: Int8, tag: Bell[4], code: Int32, slot: Int64[2] }
Label pack=4 { zone: Bolt, route: Int64, col: Int16 }
Candle pack=8 { lane: Bell, slot: Int64, route: Int8, stop: Int8, flags: Bell }
Ornament pack=2 { zone: Label[4], grade: UInt8[3], stop: Int32, col: UInt16, weight: UInt16 }
Mitten pack=8 { flags: UInt32[3], id: UInt8, slot: UInt32, mass: Label, stamp: UInt32, lane: Int64 }
Scarf pack=4 { col: Int64, row: Int8, slot: Int8, dims: Bell, code: Int64[2], flags: Int16 }
Skate pack=1 { id: UInt8[2], stop: Int32[4], stamp: Int8, lot: UInt16, flags: Int64 }
Sled pack=1 { lot: Label[2], tier: UInt32[4], weight: Int16[3] }
Drum pack=1 { slot: UInt8, code: Bell, tag: Bell, tier: Int8 }
Doll pack=1 { bay: Label[2], lot: UInt8, id: UInt16, count: UInt32, batch: Int64, route: UInt32 }
Train pack=4 { tier: Int32[3], lot: Int16, weight: UInt32 }
Kite pack=4 { mass: Bolt, weight: Int8, dims: UInt32 }
Puzzle pack=8 { stamp: UInt8, mass: UInt16, slot: UInt32, tag: Int16, weight: UInt32 }
Crate pack=2 { weight: Label, dims: Int64, seal: Puzzle[3], mass: UInt32, code: Int16, lane: UInt16, id: Kite[2] }
Pallet pack=1 { grade: UInt8[3], row: UInt16[2], lot: Int32, flags: UInt16, seal: Puzzle, mass: Bell }
Shelf pack=4 { lot: UInt32, bay: Puzzle[4], mass: Int64, slot: Puzzle, col: Int16[3], row: Int16[3] }
Bay pack=2 { stop: UInt32, zone: UInt16[4], lane: Int16, count: Drum[3], weight: Int8, slot: UInt32[2], lot: Kite }
Wagon pack=1 { weight: UInt8, row: Int64, mass: Int8, batch: Int32, grade: Int64, col: Kite }
Hangar pack=1 { count: Train[2], code: Int64[4], tier: Int64, tag: Drum, id: UInt8[2], dims: Int32, stop: Int16 }
Sack pack=1 { weight: UInt8, tier: Drum[3], bay: Skate, tag: Int64[2] }
Manifest pack=1 { bay: Pallet, mass: Puzzle, code: Shelf, count: Train, tier: Wagon, col: Drum, route: Train[2] }
